venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Tuesday 6/30 (MOD Joe):** Bingo Tuesday was a smash hit. Quiet start but a rush before 6pm for the meal deal, then a full house for bingo from 6pm with Jason hosting and high energy. Saw many familiar faces plus some investors. Almost entirely table service today. Ended June with a good number of High Five cocktails sold — continuing to lean on table tents to inform guests of activations. No barback, so MOD supported the bartender. Opener left ~9pm; the Mexico game kept guests at the bar until close. Kitchen: guests loving the snacks, keep the quality up. 86/low: low diet, coke, sprite. No incidents. Net $2,857 vs $2,190 target (+30.5%), 84 guests, $34.02 check avg, food $481, comps $88.20. Favorite moment: meeting Tyler, an investor who enjoyed himself so much he left and came back later.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Tuesday 6/30 (MOD KE & KM):** Decent Tuesday with higher traffic and participation for Bingo. Jeremy from Gallo joined with a group. Around 8pm the space began to clear (not uncommon on Tuesdays) and the usual later pop didn't materialize. Kevin held down the kitchen. Maintenance: Well 3 chiller. Low: Cointreau. No incidents. Net $1,196 vs $1,529 target (−21.8%), 39 guests, $30.65 check avg, food $262, comps $172.19 / 14.4% (bingo credits, gifts, industry). Favorite moment: a pair of gentlemen who joined later and were enthusiastic about the cocktails and their time with us.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Overcast with isolated thunder and lightning
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tuesday 6/30 (AM Chef Lucas & Maggie H / PM Evan):** Super calm Tuesday. AM started with 10 IRDs at once but smoothed out; tea and chai orders confirmed shipping, cage section refreshed. PM had weird pacing but overall decent — not crazy busy but everyone on it, crushing it with guests including Mike & Marissa celebrating their anniversary. Kitchen slow but a good time; shoutout Nate for coming in on dishes. Event: small Instacart happy hour, 24 guests 5:30–6:45pm in suite 6A — Lucas W's taco bar & garden snacks, Justice on drinks, host and guests thanked the team on the way to the Rockies game. No maintenance needs. Base net $6,879.25 vs $8,377.95 target (−17.9%), plus $2,580 net event sales (total incl. events $9,459.25). 169 guests, food $1,497.50 (base), comps $534.30 / ~7.77%. Favorite: hearing Mike & Marissa's story and their raves about Kayla.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday 6/30 (MOD Kyler + Steves):** Beautiful weather likely kept people outdoors; relatively mellow all evening with no real pop or rush. Some Mexico World Cup fans celebrating. Native Lion top seller again. Faded around 11pm — bar full, tables minimal — and by 11:30pm the floor was empty. An early Tuesday. Door: buzzing at open with 3s and 4s, flowing in at half full after 7:30pm, more duos toward 10pm; once the Mexico–Ecuador game started the streets went quiet, only ~4 at the bar by 11:30. Highlight: welcomed actor Tony Revolori (Grand Budapest Hotel, Wes Anderson & Spider-Man films). No no-shows. Net $3,270 vs $3,718 target (−12.0%), 83 guests, $38 check avg, food $478, beverage $2,755, comps $113 (F&F and manager/investor).

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **DCLA — Tuesday 6/30 (MOD Joe + Julian training, Chef Josh):** A steady Tuesday. First couple hours quiet as the Mexico World Cup game started at 6pm (rain-delayed to 7pm); 3 reservations ran late for the game. Julian trained for part-time MOD and crushed it. Mexico's victory made the Arts District very lively — Joe and Julian scoped upstairs for drunk characters but everyone was in good spirits. From 9:30pm on, a small waitlist that cleared quickly; room stayed busy to last call with a smooth close. Kitchen: oven knob coming back soon. 86 fries. No incidents. Net $3,988 vs $3,487 target (+14.4%), 110 guests, $78.21 check avg, food $1,046, comps $145 (Ray from Camphor, birthdays, investor, DNL). Favorite: hearing people screaming from Chachacha when the game ended.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DCDC — Tuesday 6/30 (MOD Cory/Josh/Marcus):** A full buyout event night — Marquee, Garden and regular F&B all $0, with the night driven entirely by a $13,020 net event. Garden closed. Kitchen sent lots of food — expected overkill but guests went through it all (shoutout James). Went well: exceeding hosts' and guests' expectations. To improve: bathroom checks. Maintenance: service entrance flooring loose, curtains coming off the rails. No incidents. Net (incl. event) $13,020 vs $5,420.86 target (+140.2%), 89 guests, event-driven check avg ~$146.29, comps $0. Favorite moment: Grant charming some tables.

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.narrative: **MG — Tuesday 6/30 (AM Justin / PM James & Marcus):** Slow morning start, only a couple hotel guests until 11a; cut to one server. Municipal Bar saw a good noon pop plus a food tour ordering good beverage volume, then back to steady/slow by 2p. Evening slow and steady with no surges — bar and restaurant never full but sparsely populated throughout; cut Eva and Tia early, Sam stayed to ~8:30 and the Carlas closed, no issues. Sun Club calm and hot; Jack trained with Kyanne and both learned inventory. Hot Eye closed. Kitchen cruised. Maintenance: Hot Eye Crisalli system pumping CO2 with no water on the gas side of the tap. No incidents. Net $3,885 vs $4,500 target (−13.7%) — AM $1,016, PM $2,490, Sun Club $141; 73 guests (22 AM / 51 PM), food $1,636, comps $83. Favorite: the whole team knocking out inventory in record time.
